module_summary: Synchronous valid/ready FIFO: 4-entry register-array storage with wrapping write/read pointers and an occupancy counter deriving full/empty handshakes.

anchors.name: mem_q
anchors.why: 4x8 entry array written at wptr on push, read at rptr for out_data.

anchors.name: in_valid
anchors.why: Write-side valid; with in_ready forms push enable.

anchors.name: in_ready
anchors.why: Write-side ready, deasserted when count reaches DEPTH (full).

anchors.name: in_data
anchors.why: Write payload stored into mem_q on push.

anchors.name: out_valid
anchors.why: Read-side valid, asserted when count nonzero (not empty).

anchors.name: out_ready
anchors.why: Read-side ready; with out_valid forms pop enable.

anchors.name: out_data
anchors.why: Read payload, mem_q entry addressed by rptr_q.

anchors.name: wptr_q
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing mem_q, increments on push, cleared by flush.

anchors.name: rptr_q
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting out_data, increments on pop, cleared by flush.

anchors.name: count_q
anchors.why: Occupancy count driving full/empty handshakes and count_o.

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Flush request clearing both pointers and count.

anchors.name: do_push
anchors.why: Push enable: writes mem_q, advances wptr, increments count.

anchors.name: do_pop
anchors.why: Pop enable: advances rptr, decrements count.

groups.name: Pointer and occupancy control
groups.description: Write/read pointers and count updated by push/pop; flush resets; count gives full/empty.
